trigger.novel_question: whether the public Predict.fun web client discloses a stable unauthenticated market-data route or embedded exact market identifiers before any mainnet API-key request

question: Does the exact public Predict.fun GPT-6 page expose enough stable web-client metadata to identify its public market-data route without credentials, account access, or authentication bypass?

endpoint_classification.operation: download one exact public rendered Predict.fun market page
endpoint_classification.security: public unauthenticated read-only GET to the same page exposed to logged-out browsers
endpoint_classification.source_contract: The retained bytes may be used only to enumerate public static assets, embedded market identifiers, and public read routes. They may not establish executable economics, eligibility, owned state, or authority.

decision.source_gate_only: If a stable public unauthenticated market-data route and exact market identifier are both present, freeze a separate one-use book contract before viewing prices. Otherwise stop this public route without trying keys, aliases, private endpoints, or browser-session extraction.
decision.conditional_next_step: Offline-enumerate only public script URLs, route strings, and market identifiers from the retained page.

retry_policy: This exact page GET is one-use. Preserve any shell, block, or missing-metadata response. Do not try API keys, aliases, private routes, session extraction, account endpoints, or executable books unless a separate prospectively frozen contract is justified by retained public metadata.
